title: NSO 1st Advance Estimates: FY26 Real GDP Growth Projected at 7.4%
summary: NSO projects real GDP to reach ₹201.90 lakh crore (7.4% growth) and nominal GDP at ₹357.14 lakh crore (8% growth).

blocks.content: National Statistical Office (NSO, MoSPI) released 1st Advance Estimates for FY2025-26, projecting **real GDP growth at 7.4%** to touch ₹201.90 lakh crore.

items: **Real GVA Growth**: 7.3% to ₹184.50 lakh crore (manufacturing/construction at 7%).
